paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen hi.
heading: Tuipi San Kanna

paite: "Israel suante kiang ah thu gen in, kihei uhenla, Pi-hahiroth ma ah, Migdol leh tuipi kikal ah, Baal-zephon zawntak ah giak uhen. Ama ah tuipi kiang ah na giak ding uh ahi.
Israel suante tungtang thu, gamdai in adaltan ziak in gamsung ah tang in abuaigawp uh, Pharaoh in chi ding ahi.

Amaute nungdelh ding in Pharaoh lungtang ka khauhsak ding. Pharaoh tung leh asepaihte tung ah zahtak in ka om ding hi. Huchi a Aiguptate'n TOUPA ka hi, chih atheihna ding un," achi hi. Huchibang in Israel suante'n ahihta uhi.

Mite apaikheta uh, chih Aigupta kumpipa ahilh uhi. Pharaoh lungtang leh asikhate lungtang mite siatna ding in hei in a-om hi. "Eite nna asepna ua pan Israel i paisak uh, bangziak a hiai hih i hi ua!" achi uhi.
Akangtalai amansak a, amite atonpihta hi.
Kangtalai hoihpen zaguk, Aigupta gam a kangtalai tengteng leh aheutute chiat uh toh atonpih hi.
TOUPA'N Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh lungtang akhauhsak a; Israel suante anungdelhta hi. Israel suante hangsantak in apaikheta uhi.
Himahleh Aiguptate'n Pharaoh sakol tengteng leh kangtalai tengteng, sakol tungtuang mite leh sepaih pawlte toh anungdelh ua, Baal-zephon ma a Pi-hahiroth pam a tuipi kiang a agiahna uah aphata uhi.
Pharaoh in ahon naih lai in, Israel suante adaktou ua, ngai in, Aiguptate'n amau ahon delhta uhi. Alau mahmah ua, Israel suante TOUPA kiang ah akapkhia uhi.
Mosi kiang ah, "Aigupta gam a han a-om louh ziak a gamdai a si dia hon pikhia na hi maw! Bang achia hichibang a hon bawl dia Aigupta gam a kipan hon pikhia na hia?
Aigupta gam a ka hon hilh uh hiai thu ahi kei maw? Om maimai ni, Aiguptate nna i septheihna ding in," chi in. "Gamdai a ka sih sang ua, koute a dia Aiguptate nasep ahoih zawk ding ziak in," achi uhi.
Mosi in mite kiang ah, "Lau kei unla, dingh dinden un, TOUPA hotdamna tuni a nou ahon etsak ding en un; tuni a na muh uh Aiguptate tangtawn a mu nawn lou ding na hih ziak un.
TOUPA'N nou a ding in ahon dousak dia, na pau kei ding uh," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Bang achia ka kiang a kap na hia? Malam a apaina ding un, Israel suante kiang ah thu gen in.
Na chiangkhun lik inla, tuipi tung ah na khut zankhia in, kikhensak in. Huchi in Israel suante tuipi laizang ah leihul ah apaisuak ding uhi.
Ngai in, ke'n Aiguptate lungtang ka khauhsak ding a; amaute adelhzui ding uhi. Pharaoh tung ah, akangtalaite tung ah leh asakol tungtuang mite tung ah zahtakhuaina ka kimuh ding hi.
Pharaoh tung, akangtalaite tung leh asakol tungtuang mite tung a zahtakhuaina ka kimuh chiang in, kei TOUPA ka hi, chih Aiguptate'n athei ding uh," achi hi.
Israelte giahphual ma a pai, Pathian angel akisuan a, anunglam uah apai a; amailam ua kipan meipi dingh akisuan a, anunglam uah adinghta hi.

Aiguptate giahphual leh Israelte giahphual kikal ah ahong omta a; amaute a ding in meipi leh khomial ahi a; himahleh zan in hiaite a ding in vak apia hi; huchi a zankhua a kuamah kinaihtuah thei zaw sam a-omlouhna ding un.
Mosi in tuipi tung ah akhut azankhia a; TOUPA'n zankhua in suahlam huih hat in tuipi apaikiksak a, gam hul in tuipi abawl a, tuite akikhenta hi.
Tuipi lak a gam hul tung ah Israel suante apai ua; akhut taklam uh leh akhut veilam uah amau a ding in tuite baang ahong hita uhi.
Aiguptate'n adelh ua, Pharaoh sakol tengteng, akangtalai tengteng leh asakol tungtuangmi tengteng nangawn tuipi lak ah amau nung ah apailut uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, zingsang ahong hihtak in TOUPA'N meikuang khuampi dingh leh meipi khuampi dingh kawm ah Aigupta sepaihte lam a-en a, Aigupta sepaihte ahihbuaita hi.
Akangtalai khete uh alakkhiaksak a, haksapi in ahawl ua; Aiguptate'n, "Israelte ma a pan taikek ni; amaute a ding in TOUPA'N lah Aiguptate siatna ding in adousak ngal a," achi uhi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Aiguptate tung leh akangtalaite tung leh asakol tungtuang mite tung a tuite ahong kizop nawn theihna ding in, tuipi tung ah na khut zankhia in," achi hi.
Mosi in tuipi tung ah akhut azankhia a, zingsang ahong hih in tuipi ahatna ah ahong kik nawn a; Aiguptate alak ah ataikek ua; tuipi lak ah TOUPA'N Aiguptate athalpaihta hi.
Tuite ahong kik nawn ua, kangtalaite, sakol tungtuang mite leh Pharaoh sepaih anung ua hong lut tengteng tui in akhuhta hi. Alak uah khat lel leng dam a suakta a-om kei uh.
Himahleh tuipi lak ah gam hul tung ah Israel suante apai ua; akhut taklam uleh, aveilam uah tuite amaute a ding in baang ahita hi.
Huchibang in TOUPA'N huai ni in Aiguptate khut a pan Israelte ahondamta hi. Israelte'n tuipi piau ah Aiguptate' misi amu uhi.
Aiguptate tung a anasep thupi Israelte'n amu ua, huchi in TOUPA leh asikha Mosi agingtata uhi.
